text:
maya: Quick accessibility pass on the Model Details panel — ran keyboard nav + VoiceOver. Notes: model title not in rotor, example prompts low contrast, version selector announced as button but not reading value. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/notes/mdl-panel.png

sam: Thx Maya. Which OS/browser and a short repro?

maya: macOS 12.6, Safari 16, VoiceOver. Repro: Tab into panel, VO+Right — title missing from rotor; example cards read as plain text; measured contrast ~3.8:1 (#8a8a8a on #f7f7f7). Version combobox announced as "button" and doesn't speak selected item.

alex: For rotor we should use a real <h2>. Avoid tabindex hacks. For examples, if they copy/expand they must be buttons. Contrast: bump to #626262 for 4.5:1.

sam: I'll handle markup fixes. Are example cards interactive today?

maya: Yes — copy to clipboard and expand details. Right now they're divs. Also focus ring is too subtle — using `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,140,255,0.15)` which disappears on light cards.

tina: a11y-bot scan: contrast failures -> example-card-text (3.79), truncated-label (2.6). Missing attrs: version-selector missing aria-haspopup/aria-expanded, model-meta region missing aria-label.

jeff: Prioritize: 1) semantic controls for examples (keyboard order), 2) version selector should announce value, 3) update tokens. Need a small design+implementation plan.

alex: Plan: (a) swap example divs -> `<button class="example-card" aria-expanded="false">` (b) set `--card-text: #3a3a3a` (c) change focus to `outline: 2px solid #2d8cff`. I'll mock in Figma.

sam: Opening PR with semantic headings + div->button + color token updates: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1423 — needs UX/a11y review.

maya: Quick nits: icon-only buttons need aria-label; when example expands aria-expanded toggles but focus remains on trigger — users expect focus to move into content sometimes.

tina: Suggestion: either move focus to first focusable in the expanded panel or keep focus and ensure aria-controls points to the region with role=region and an accessible name.

jeff: Can we do a 15m handoff after merge to validate VoiceOver?

alex: Scheduled 15m sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. I'll add a QA checklist to the PR with VoiceOver steps, tab order, contrast checks.

maya: LGTM after aria tweaks. I'll re-run VoiceOver after staging deploy. :thumbsup: 

sam: Merged to branch and deploying to staging — tagging @maya for verification.

a11y-bot: Staging scan (post-PR): updated tokens pass contrast, navigation improvements detected. Remaining warning: "expanded region lacks accessible name" — add aria-label or aria-labelledby.

maya: Verified on staging: rotor shows model title, examples announced as buttons, version selector reads selected value. One last nit: expanded content not announced when opened — adding `aria-live="polite"` to expansion region would surface dynamic content.

alex: Will add `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-label` on expanded region. Thanks for the pass!

tina: Final automated check queued; will post results in PR.

jeff: Nice quick turnaround, thanks everyone.
